source: Adeia press release: Adeia Enters into Multi-Year IP License Renewal with TCL (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer TCL Electronics: TCL Electronics Holdings Limited (TCL), which Adeia calls one of the world's largest television manufacturers, entered into a multi-year renewal of its license to Adeia's media intellectual property portfolio. Chief revenue officer Dr. Mark Kokes said the renewal 'reflects the continued relevance of our media portfolio as smart TVs become increasingly important platforms for streaming, content discovery, personalization, advertising and connected consumer experiences.' No financial terms are stated.
